description: Messages use chosen input strings. A failing message guard is exercised through the library hook.

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%features early late
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text *early
%rule early A %warning "early warning" %emits $ :: B
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text *late *bad
%rule late ε %warning "late warning"
%rule bad B %error "bad value " ++ $.value
```
